about: Authored schema for this lane only. One battle exchange as a timed event list. Fills the sequencing gap between the existing treatments module (which knows windup/travel/hold/recoil/recover durations) and the hit-stop stack staged in step1-attack-hurt/. No third-party code is staged here.
invariants: contact, flash, spark and impact sound share the same timestamp (frame 0 of the hit).
hp_drain_start is never earlier than hold_end.
hitstop_frames scales with attack weight: light 2, medium 5, heavy 8, critical 12 (see step1 hit-stop spec).
A skipped / 2x-speed playback mode must compress durations, never reorder events.

wiring_target.target_module: battle view / battle treatments module: emit these events in this order; the renderer subscribes, it does not re-derive order
